info.title: Signal Audit API
info.description:
Measures how many independent signals a set of metrics actually carries, and which columns can be removed without losing information.

**Headline figures use first-differenced series.** Metrics that all grow over time correlate from shared trend alone; the raw view is returned alongside so the gap is visible.

**Executable exports are gated.** The engine proves statistical redundancy; it cannot see that a metric is the sole condition on a paging monitor. A completed blast-radius worksheet is required before Terraform or exclusion plans are returned.

**No cost figure is synthesised.** Column redundancy and billing cardinality differ by orders of magnitude, so savings estimates require customer-supplied unit cost and, ideally, a cardinality map.

post.summary: Shape, quota verdict and execution mode without analysing
post.description:
Shape, quota verdict and execution mode WITHOUT running the
analysis. Lets the client show limits and set expectations before
committing to a long job.

post.summary: Run an audit (inline when small, queued when large)
post.description:
Run an audit.

mode=auto (default) runs inline when small and queues when large,
per the tier's threshold. The response always states which happened,
so a client never has to infer it from the shape of the body.

Basis declaration. `basis` names which lens the headline reports:
raw, differenced, or ratio:COL. `scale_by` is a comma-separated list
of denominators, each adding one ratio basis; `scale_exempt` names
columns that are ALREADY scale-free and must not be divided —
dividing a rate by a size injects the very confound the ratio basis
removes. All optional: omitting them reproduces the previous
response exactly, and the contract reports `basis.declared: false`
so a client can enforce what the server does not.

`require_basis=true` makes the server refuse an undeclared request.
It is opt-in rather than default because defaulting it on would
break every existing caller.

get.summary: Job status, and the contract once complete

get.description:
Consumption for the current account. Sums the metering unit
across completed audits; a real deployment reads this from the
billing store rather than from job memory.

get.summary: What can be downloaded now, and what is gated
get.description:
What can be downloaded now, and what is still gated behind the
blast-radius attestation.

The artefact that should be requested first: statistical evidence
pre-filled, operational columns blank for the operator.
Keep/drop per column. A document, not a change — ungated.

post.summary: Reversible Terraform; requires a completed worksheet
post.description:
Reversible Terraform, unlocked by a completed review worksheet.

Requires the worksheet as an upload rather than a checkbox: the
attestation is per metric, and a single 'I confirm' control cannot
represent that a reviewer checked eleven metrics against four
systems each.

post.summary: Reversible exclusion plan (JSON); requires a worksheet
Re-price an audit against your own unit cost
post.description:
Re-price an existing audit against customer-supplied parameters.

Separate from the audit itself so a customer can adjust unit cost and
cardinality without paying for a re-analysis.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: Content hash. Stable across re-runs of the same data; the natural idempotency key.

metric_badges.title: Metric Badges
metric_badges.description: Structural badges per metric, from a closed vocabulary. A metric may carry several.

basis.description: Added in contract 1.1. Absent from responses generated before that version; never absent from new ones.

excluded_columns.title: Excluded Columns
excluded_columns.description: Columns not audited, each with a reason. Must be shown: a column vanishing silently turns an audit into an audit of something else.

BasisConflict.title: BasisConflict
BasisConflict.description:
A pair a transform made MORE correlated than it was.

Ambiguous by nature and deliberately not resolved server-side: the
basis either injected a shared factor (a defect) or exposed a real
duplicate (a finding). Dividing ROA and ROE by total assets took r
from +0.60 to +0.98 -- injected. Dividing net income by total assets
took its correlation with ROA from +0.06 to +0.9997 -- exposed,
because that quotient IS return on assets. Same signature.

declared.title: Declared
declared.description: False means the engine assumed a basis rather than being told one.

BasisInfo.title: BasisInfo
BasisInfo.description:
Which lens produced the headline, and whether anyone chose it.

`declared` is the field a CI client should assert on. False means
the engine fell back to treating rows as ordered observations --
an assumption that fails SILENTLY on entity-indexed data, returning
very nearly the right number for the wrong reason. The server does
not refuse an undeclared request by default, because that would
break every existing caller; it states the assumption instead and
lets the client enforce.

BasisSummary.title: BasisSummary
BasisSummary.description: One computed basis. Every basis is computed on every run.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when no unit cost was supplied. No figure is synthesised: column redundancy and billing cardinality differ by orders of magnitude.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: Display these next to the figure, not behind a tooltip.

unit_cost_per_series_month.title: Unit Cost Per Series Month
unit_cost_per_series_month.description: From your own contract. No vendor price list is held server-side, because a stale constant would produce wrong figures indefinitely.

series_per_metric.title: Series Per Metric
series_per_metric.description: Billable series per column. Supplying this for every affected metric is what raises confidence from low to medium.

match_fraction.title: Match Fraction
match_fraction.description: Fraction of rows on which the metric EQUALS the aggregate. Equality, not correlation.

r.title: R
r.description: Near zero by selection: these pairs look independent to correlation.

mi_vs_gaussian.title: Mi Vs Gaussian
mi_vs_gaussian.description: Empirical mutual information as a multiple of what a Gaussian with the same r would carry.

basis.description: What the recommendation rests on. Blockers are scoped to this: sparse history weakens a unique_variance judgement but not an identity.

keep_as_representative.title: Keep As Representative
keep_as_representative.description: True for the surviving member of an identity pair. Never recommended for deletion — removing both halves destroys the quantity.

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.description: Reasons not to act. Empty is required for recommended=true.

independent_signals.title: Independent Signals
independent_signals.description: Participation ratio of the correlation spectrum. Continuous, so rarely a whole number.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: raw minus differenced. Large negative values mean the raw view is mostly shared calendar trend.

headline_basis.title: Headline Basis
headline_basis.description: Always differenced. Metrics that all grow over time correlate for that reason alone.

billable_cells.title: Billable Cells
billable_cells.description: The metering unit. Computed from data actually analysed, after dropped columns and listwise deletion.

tags.name: exports
tags.description: Cleanup artefacts. Nothing generated is destructive: Terraform collapses cardinality via tag configuration and is reversed by restoring tags.
